system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each LLM stage in the workflow uses a modular prompt template with the same general organization, while the content of each section is specialized to the task at hand.
system_prompt_style.note: Harness code is not public (only pseudocode per Data Availability). The pinned repo openSIL/openSIL is the target firmware, not the harness.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: First, a VDB implemented using Chroma stores and retrieves existing functions (knowledge base), existing UTs (ground truth), and reusable test doubles (libraries).
env_context_strategy.note: VDB retrieval can be disabled (LCA-only configuration, Sec. 5.2). LCOV hit/miss maps are also injected.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no harness code, so no place where history handling would be declared.

observation_format.evidence_quote: It applies small edits based on compiler/linker errors and on dispatch/coverage logs, where careful reasoning helps avoid breaking the build.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Each LLM step must return its output in a fixed format, so the workflow can reliably read and apply it.
tool_call_format.note: Structured output schemas via LangChain. The exact mechanism (native structured output vs JSON in text) is unstated. Closest value chosen.

tool_count.note: Fixed pipeline of nodes; no tool list reported and no harness code available.

edit_primitive.note: Drafting emits whole files (ut_c, ut_h) and repair returns 'small, specific edits', but the edit format is unspecified.

protocol_standardization.note: No harness source or dependency list available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The workflow consists of an initial UT generation phase followed by an automated repair loop driven by compiler, linker, and coverage feedback.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This section provides the stage-by-stage procedure the model should follow.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: this paper presents a workflow using multiple specialized LLM agents: some draft the initial UT files, others fix build issues using compiler/linker logs

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: handles the workflow orchestration as a set of steps (nodes) with iterative loops
delegation_mechanism.note: Hand-off between LangGraph nodes over shared state. Closest value chosen.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: In interactive mode, this node allows users to provide feedback to the LLM, which will be used to guide the next fix/refinement step.
human_in_loop.note: The human reviews at the round gate in interactive mode. Evaluation used non-interactive mode; the default is not stated.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Initializes workflow state and validates inputs.

long_term_memory.note: The VDB holds pre-existing project code and tests, not memory written by prior runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Compile the test under EDK II, then run the dispatcher when the build succeeds.
self_verification.note: self_critique comes from the prompt Validation section (Sec. 4.8): the model checks its own output before returning it.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The system maintains a structured loop that continues until either a coverage threshold is reached or a maximum number of iterations is exceeded.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: (ii) coverage stops improving under break_point_2, or (iii) the workflow reaches its set iteration limit.
termination_condition.note: test_pass is used for the coverage threshold (90% by default), which is the closest value.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The workflow was instantiated with three commercially available LLMs selected to balance capability and computational cost.
cost_controls.note: This is a static per-stage model assignment, not dynamic routing. Closest value chosen.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: All experiments ran on a Windows machine with the EDK II build environment installed
execution_isolation.note: Inferred host builds; LCOV runs via WSL.

tracing.note: Compile and run logs are saved, but no harness code is available to determine the tracing level.

guardrails.evidence_quote: If a symbol is on the list, the workflow avoids generating a new definition for it.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This study introduces an automated UT authoring workflow for the Open-Source Silicon Initialization Library (openSIL) firmware codebase

open_source.evidence_quote: Additional code used in this work cannot be made publicly available due to legal and contractual restrictions
open_source.note: Only pseudocode is released. openSIL itself is MIT-licensed but is the target, not the harness.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: while the LLM interactions are managed throughLangChain ChatOpenAI
model_agnostic.note: Only OpenAI models are used, although LangChain could abstract providers.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: A pseudocode representation of the workflow pipeline developed in this study is provided as Supplementary Material

first_release_date.note: No harness repo exists. The evidence shows only arXiv v2 (21 Jun 2026); the v1 date is absent.

pinned_version.note: The bundled repo openSIL genoa_poc@632b97619c45 is the target firmware, not the harness. The paper used the phoenix_poc branch.

stars.note: No harness repo exists. The openSIL target repo has 590 stars.
